pictures.name: SM1-First-Garden
pictures.prompt: A vast, untouched garden at the first dawn of the world: enormous ancient trees, still water, mist, the sky opening in gold. In a far glade, a soft circle of glowing lights rests low over the grass, like lamps with no lamps. Peaceful and full of awe. No people or human figures of any kind. The angels appear only as soft points of light, never as figures or faces. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
